notes: GiVo Server 1.0 (build 58) for macOS, Windows and Linux/Docker. Fixes the portal cursor file being rewritten with unloaded memos after a restart (a retired guide lane could come back and hit the provider's rate limit hourly), plus review fixes: a sweep only counts as cut short on a real provider rate limit, the low-yield count resets on retirement and lapse, Clear Data purges every portal memo, the bulk-window re-settle only touches a settled ladder, and the once-more guide retry survives a re-arm.
